content: We represent a document as a statistical word co-occurrence network BIBREF18, BIBREF19 with a sliding window of size 2 overspanning sentences. Let us denote that graph $G(V,E)$. Each unique word in the preprocessed document is represented by a node in $G$, and an edge is added between two nodes if they are found together in at least one instantiation of the window. $G$ is directed and weighted: edge directions and weights respectively capture text flow and co-occurrence counts.
